name: Eudaemonian
originalText:
### Eudaemonian

- **Path Type:** Expert
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 3
- **PDF Page:** 3

```text
Eudaemonian (Expert Path)
Ever have you striven to live a virtuous life. You consider
your every word and action to ensure that you do no
unwarranted harm. Your unwillingness to “let go” or “live
it up” could come at some personal cost; others rarely
understand your commitment to a decent life and might
be disappointed or even disgusted by your moral purity.
Whatever difficulties you face fade from memory when you
feel the presence of the eudaemons come upon you.

These invisible entities gather around and lend you
comfort and support. When you face an insurmountable
task, your courage rises. When you feel tempted toward
some selfish action, something steels your resolve to keep
you on the middle path. Rather than champion these
virtues or seek to impose them on others, you exemplify
their value through your actions and commitment to moral
causes.

LEVEL 3 EUDAEMONIAN
Attributes: Increase two different attributes by 1.
Characteristics: Perception +1, Health +4, Power +1
Languages and Professions: You can speak another
language or add a profession to your list of professions.
Magic: You discover a new tradition or learn one spell
from a tradition you have already discovered.
Virtuous Nature: You impose 1 bane on attack rolls against
you from demons, faeries, spirits, and undead. Your
attacks against such creatures ignore Spell Defense if
they have that trait.

LEVEL 6 EUDAEMONIAN
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: You learn one spell from a tradition you have
discovered already.
Second Binding: You bond with two eudaemons.
Virtuous Mind: You make Will challenge rolls to resist
harmful effects with 1 boon.

LEVEL 9 EUDAEMONIAN
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: You learn one spell from a tradition you have
discovered already.
Ultimate Binding: You bond with all four eudaemons.
Virtuous Sacrifice: When you take damage, you can end
your bond with one eudaemon of your choice to halve
the damage you take. The bond remains ended until
you complete a rest.
```
